pieces.doc: Optional indicator slot inside a `ForCheckbox`. Apply on the element the consumer wants to show only while the checkbox is `checked` or `indeterminate` (typically a check icon, dash, or filled square). The directive flips `[hidden]` and mirrors `data-state` from the parent so the consumer can style transitions without per-state bindings.

Headless checkbox implementing the [WAI-ARIA Checkbox pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/checkbox/) with optional tri-state (`indeterminate`) support, plus Angular's `FormCheckboxControl` from `@angular/forms/signals` for `[formField]` auto-wiring.

models.name: checked
models.doc: Two-way bindable on/off state. Required by `FormCheckboxControl`.

models.name: indeterminate
models.doc: Two-way bindable indeterminate state. When true, `aria-checked="mixed"` is announced regardless of `checked`. Activation clears it.
